sentences.text: ORAL ORDER 1.

The present application is filed under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, for regular bail in connection with C.R.No.11204067230055 of 2023 registered with Sevaliya Police Station, District Kheda for the offence punishable under Sections 306, 498A and 114, etc. of the Indian Penal Code.

2. Learned advocate Mr. Raxit Dholakia appearing on behalf of the applicant submits that considering the nature of the offence, the applicant may be enlarged on regular bail by imposing suitable conditions.
It is further submitted that the so- called unfortunate incident occurred on 18.02.2023.
The present applicant accused is arrested on 19.02.2023.
The investigation is already completed and after submission of the NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/11924/2023 ORDER DATED: 07/11/2023 undefined charge-sheet, present bail application is preferred.
The FIR is registered against four accused persons and except the present applicant, rest of the co-accused persons have already been enlarged either on regular bail or on anticipatory bail.

sentences.text: Mr. Dholakia submits that span of marriage is around three years and out of the said wedlock, a baby girl child is born.
The allegations levelled against the present applicant accused are general and vague in nature.
Thus, considering the law of parity and other surrounding circumstances, present applicant accused may be enlarged on bail.
3. Learned APP Mr. Soni has objected present bail application with vehemence and submitted that the role of the present applicant accused is found out from the compilation of charge-sheet papers.

The applicant is the husband of the deceased and marriage span is only three years and out of the said wedlock, a baby girl child was born, who is six months old and the deceased has committed suicide leaving behind her infant child which clearly goes to show that torture was meted out to the deceased.
Thus, bail application of the applicant may not be granted.
4. Learned advocates appearing on behalf of the respective parties do not press for further reasoned order.
5. I have heard the learned advocates appearing on NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/11924/2023 ORDER DATED: 07/11/2023 undefined behalf of the respective parties.
I have perused the police papers and other documents produced by the applicant along with the memo of the application.
It is found out from the record that the investigation is already completed and after submission of the charge-sheet present application is preferred.
The applicant accused is in jail since 19.02.2023.

The allegations levelled against the applicant accused are general and vague in nature and other co-accused persons have already been enlarged either on anticipatory bail or on regular bail by the Coordinate Bench of this Court as well as learned Sessions Court.
Thus, considering the totality of the facts of the present case, I am inclined to consider the case of the applicant.

6. This Court has also taken into consideration the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Sanjay Chandra v. Central Bureau of Investigation, reported in [2012]1 SCC 40 as well as in case of Satender Kumar Antil v. Central Bureau of Investigation & Anr. reported in (2022)10 SCC 51.
7.

The authorities will release the applicant only if he is not required in connection with any other offence for the time being.

If breach of NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/11924/2023 ORDER DATED: 07/11/2023 undefined any of the above conditions is committed, the Sessions Judge concerned will be free to issue warrant or take appropriate action in the matter.

11. The present application stands allowed accordingly.
